description:
Thumbnails in the shared index by what the picture shows (q), or like a picture
    (image_url: read once by the model as subject, action, words and setting, then
    searched). Each result has matched_by (text or meaning). Free; image reads at most 60
    an hour. Same as GET /v1/index/thumbnails and POST /v1/index/thumbnails/by-image.

image_url.description: instead of q: a public https picture or a YouTube video link; it is read once by the model, then searched
image_url.title: Image Url

q.description: what the picture shows, e.g. person pointing at a chart
q.title: Q

name: search_thumbnails
